interface.shortDescription: Author and ship Boardwalk agent workflows from Codex.
interface.longDescription: A thin Codex plugin bundling CLI-oriented skills for installing and driving the `boardwalk` CLI — scaffold a workflow, validate it, deploy it, trigger real runs, and follow the logs.
defaultPrompt: Install the Boardwalk CLI and scaffold a new workflow.
Validate my Boardwalk workflow package and fix whatever it reports.
Deploy this workflow to my Boardwalk org and trigger a run.
